precise_lean_suggestion.placement: Inside MathGauge.ConvexCost, after the existing shared variable declarations and immediately before reconstruct_maximal_ereal.
precise_lean_suggestion.declaration:
/-- Every minorant with a closed real-height epigraph lies below the reconstruction. -/
theorem reconstruct_maximal_ereal_of_isClosed_real_epigraph
    {f : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : ConvexCost f) (hp : ∃ x, f x ≠ ⊤)
    (h : E → EReal)
    (hclosed : IsClosed {p : E × ℝ | h p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)})
    (hle : ∀ x, h x ≤ (f x : EReal)) :
    ∀ x, h x ≤ (reconstruct f x : EReal) := by
  have hsub : closure (epigraph f) ⊆ {p : E × ℝ | h p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)} := by
    apply closure_minimal _ hclosed
    intro p hp'
    have he : ((ENNReal.ofReal p.2 : ℝ≥0∞) : EReal) = (p.2 : EReal) := by
      rw [EReal.coe_ennreal_ofReal, max_eq_left hp'.1]
    exact (hle p.1).trans (he ▸ EReal.coe_ennreal_le_coe_ennreal_iff.mpr hp'.2)
  intro x
  rw [reconstruct_eq_affineHull]
  by_cases hx : affineHull f x = ⊤
  · simp [hx]
  have hm : (x, (affineHull f x).toReal) ∈ epigraph (affineHull f) :=
    ⟨ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hx).ge⟩
  rw [epigraph_affineHull_eq_closure hf hp] at hm
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, EReal.coe_ennreal_toReal hx] using hsub hm

precise_lean_suggestion.alternative_equivalence_proof: For h:E→EReal, closed epi_R(h) gives each real sublevel {x:h(x)≤a} as the preimage under x↦(x,a). The +∞ sublevel is E; the -∞ sublevel is the intersection of these closed real sublevels over a∈ℝ. Every EReal level is thus closed, so lowerSemicontinuous_iff_isClosed_preimage gives Lean LowerSemicontinuous h. The converse is precisely the continuous-preimage proof already present. This is a mathematical proof sketch, not a claim that a new Lean lemma has been compiled.
